question_text: A 35-year-old woman from San Francisco has been refusing to vaccinate her children due to the claims that vaccinations may cause autism in children. When the child was taken to a clinic, the physician noticed swollen lymph nodes behind the ears of the child. Which of the following are characteristics of the virus causing these symptoms?
